answerText.c-1: Use sum += n % 10; so each digit is accumulated.
answerText.c-2: Use #define SQUARE(x) ((x) * (x)) so the argument is evaluated safely.
answerText.c-3: Initialize max from a[0] (or INT_MIN) so all-negative arrays work.
answerText.c-4: Use char s[6] = "hello"; to leave room for the null terminator.
answerText.c-5: Pass the address: increment(int *x), update *x, and call increment(&a).
answerText.dsa-1: Only loop while i < n / 2 so each pair is swapped once.
answerText.dsa-2: Assign min = j when a[j] is smaller.
answerText.dsa-3: Advance the bounds with low = mid + 1 and high = mid - 1.
answerText.dsa-4: Check top >= MAX - 1 before pushing into a MAX-element array.
answerText.dsa-5: Save next = cur->next before changing cur->next, then advance cur = next.
answerText.python-1: Copy the list with b = a.copy() (or b = list(a)).
answerText.python-2: Build independent rows with [[0] * 3 for _ in range(3)].
answerText.python-3: Test membership with if ch in "aeiou":.
answerText.python-4: Declare global x inside update() before changing it.
answerText.python-5: Use lengths[w] = len(w) so every word is a separate key.
answerText.dbms-1: Select dept, COUNT(*) and GROUP BY dept; do not select an ungrouped employee name.
answerText.dbms-2: Compare salary with a subquery: salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM emp).
